text:
Sam H: hey team — quick late-run async standup. TL;DR: finished the kv-caching spike, saw 2 eval regressions on the spanish promptset, leaving a small PR for review.
Maya R: nice. what regressed?
Sam H: short: hallucination rate up for the date-normalization examples, and an off-by-one token in the kv warmup case.
Ravi K: can you paste the failing prompt examples?
Sam H: sure — from the failing eval batch: 
```
prompt: "Fecha: 05/06/22 -> normalize to iso"
expected: "2022-06-05"
model: "2022-05-06"  # swapped day/month
```
Maya R: hmm, looks like tokenizer split for dd/mm vs mm/dd edgecases. possible locale flag dropped during preprocessing.
Sophia L: fyi I had a look at the batch pipeline yesterday — we changed the locale default in the staging preprocess config to `en_US` when enabling template-matching. might explain it.
Sam H: that explains it. blocker: need a quick hotfix in preprocess to preserve original locale metadata for the prompt bucket.
Lee: rolling canary windows are open now (eu-west-1). want me to stage the fix on canary or do you prefer a patch PR first?
Sam H: PR first so CI catches the other regressions — I already opened it: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-pipelines/pull/412 (small change in normalizer).
Ravi K: adding a code review ping — on it. I can take the CR after lunch.
Maya R: I can add a couple of new eval cases to the promptset to guard dd/mm mm/dd ambiguities. will push to the prompt repo.
Sam H: thanks — new testcases should include ambiguous numeric dates and spelled-month variants.
Sophia L: also saw the eval-bot flagged a drop in BLEU for the spanish paraphrase set — low priority but let's track it.
eval-bot: automated-notice: regression detected on branch `kv-spike` — tests failed: 2/142 (date-normalize, paraphrase-bleu). Full diff at https://ci.redwood/inference/3456
Sam H: noted. action items: 1) Ravi reviews PR #412 (Sam) 2) Maya adds ambiguous-date tests (Maya) 3) Sam monitors canary after PR merge (Sam/Lee) 4) Sophia to open a follow-up ticket for paraphrase BLEU dip (Sophia).
Ravi K: quick Q — does the kv warmup change require a prod-migration? or just config flip?
Sam H: no migration; just config revert for locale handling and a small fix in `preprocess/normalizer.py`. no DB schema changes.
Maya R: ETA: I'll push the promptset update in ~2 hours, linking the new eval cases in the PR description.
Lee: once PR is merged, I'll kick the canary run and watch token-latency metrics (cc @eng-oncall if anything unusual).
Sophia L: I'll open the paraphrase ticket and assign to the eval triage board, adding baseline metrics.
Sam H: sweet. anything else?
Maya R: one tiny ask — can we add a short comment in the promptset explaining the locale intent, so future editors don't accidentally change default?
Sam H: good call, add a one-liner in the prompt metadata.
Ravi K: acked, will review PR later today. :thumbsup:
Sam H: thanks all — will post a short follow-up when PR is merged and canary green.
Maya R: thanks!
Sophia L: thanks — logging this in the sprint board under "onboard/evals".
Lee: also tagging #eng-sre for observability checklist once canary runs.
Sam H: closing the loop — root cause likely locale default; low-risk patch. moving to done after merge.
